test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

He best understand that / because of the fight it is no / longer his decision to make.

options.text: because of the fight it is no

solution:
The correct answer is "**He best understand that**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is in the use of "He best understand."
 
• **Subjects and verbs should match in person (first, second, or third) and number (singular or plural).**
 
• **Now, in the given sentence, the subject is third person singular "he."**
 
• **Thus, we should use the third person present form of the verb "understand" i.e. "understands."**
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• He best understands that because of the fight it is no longer his decision to make.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
